purpose: Teach: コピペ/うんこ/メイル/クリエーター/できよ/チョー/シャラ/コットン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コピペ文化のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer told you about copy-paste culture, didn't they?
lines.style: Warm, curious. Soft opening. Mei is gently drawing out what Aoi noticed. Slow enough to invite Aoi to share more. Intimate but not intrusive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様が「うんこ」って繰り返す時期だって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and they were laughing about their kid being in that phase where they just repeat "unko" over and over.
lines.style: Light amusement, slightly knowing. Quick rhythm with just enough breath to show Aoi's suppressed smile. Comfortable observational tone—noticing the absurdity without mocking it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メイル、つまりメールでお取引されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They handle their business through email, right? That's how they do things.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Mei is piecing together the picture of this person. Measured pace, gentle curiosity. Not looking for a big reveal—just following the thread of who this customer is.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フリーのクリエーターとしてご活躍だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned they work as a freelance creator.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Aoi is continuing the quiet inventory of this person's life. Even-paced, no judgment. The tone of someone sharing details that mattered enough for the customer to mention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「お代わりできよ」って古風な口調で仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They used that old-fashioned phrase, didn't they—"o-kawari dekiyo" when they asked for a refill.
lines.style: Slight amusement underneath. Mei catching the detail and savoring it. Gentle tease in the delivery, but affectionate. The way you point out a small, charming thing someone did without making them self-conscious about it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様が「チョー楽しい」って連発してたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their grandkid was keeping them company—kept saying "chō tanoshii" about everything.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Aoi's voice softens here—noticing the joy between them. Quick, light energy on the repetition of the phrase. The rhythm of a child's enthusiasm captured in her delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テニスのシャラポワがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're a tennis fan—Maria Sharapova's their favorite.
lines.style: Warm listing. Mei quietly cataloguing another piece. No rush. The tone of someone building a portrait of a person they're beginning to know through fragments.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コットンの天然素材がお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Soft, trailing close. Aoi finishing the small portrait with one more detail. Quiet satisfaction in noticing. Breath fades gently at the end, like the last piece clicking into place.
